register_all_coco: register all COCO dataset splits including instances, keypoints, and panoptic variants to the DatasetCatalog
register_all_lvis: register all LVIS dataset splits including v1 and v0.5 variants to the DatasetCatalog
register_all_cityscapes: register all Cityscapes instance and semantic segmentation dataset splits to the DatasetCatalog
register_all_pascal_voc: register all PASCAL VOC 2007 and 2012 dataset splits to the DatasetCatalog
register_all_ade20k: register ADE20K semantic segmentation train and validation splits to the DatasetCatalog
